about: Cases for the Zen widget library licence-banner rule (scripts/zen-lib/banners.mjs). Every port of the rule must give `pass` for each case: scripts/zen-lib/check-banners.mjs --self-test and the partner build's licence-allow.py read this file. A case's input is `text`, with `{{pad}}` replaced by `pad.unit` repeated `pad.times` times when `pad` is given. `id` is the zen-lib.json id, `licence` the row's SPDX expression. Byte offsets are UTF-8.

cases.name: the standard banner
cases.text:
/*! acme 1.0.0 | MIT | Copyright (c) 2020 Acme | full text: Third-party notices */
code()

cases.name: a multi-line /*! upstream banner with License: and (c)
cases.text:
/*!
  Acme v1.0.0
  (c) 2006-2026 Acme and other contributors
  License: BSD-3-Clause
 */
code()
